item: Focus-confirmed viewed acknowledge: on focus, POST the observed idle transition as the session's viewed watermark (upstream 250ms->5s retry while the route shows an unread session).
reason: The client state machine (ViewAcknowledgement) and the server route both exist, but the CLI never learns the session's idle-transition timestamp, so no live code can observe unread or post the watermark. There is also no CLI POST to the view route.

dead_client_helper.note: struct + new/observe/unread/poll/failed/succeeded/attempts; only caller is #[cfg(test)] tab_21_focus_confirmed_ack_retries_250ms_to_5s at :2220-2248. Zero non-test callers across crates/.

no_cli_post: grep for POST '/api/sessions/{id}/view' in crates/cli returns 0 matches; the route '/api/sessions/{id}/view' is registered server-side only (crates/server/src/lib.rs:236, view_session :1229).

server_side_ready.note: view_session: parses {idle: i64 millis}, applies monotone watermark via set_viewed, returns 204
set_viewed applies time_viewed = max(idle, coalesce(viewed, idle))
server test proves the watermark round-trips

missing_seam.producer_required: The idle-transition timestamp ('time.idle') for each session must reach the CLI: neither GET /api/sessions (SessionSummary) nor GET /api/sessions/{id} carries an idle field today. grep for idle_at|time_idle|idleSince|idle_since across crates/contracts, crates/server, crates/sessions returns 0 matches. Without idle the CLI cannot compute isUnread (idle > viewed) and cannot know what watermark to post.

upstream_source_of_idle.quote: const isUnread = (sessionID) => { const info = data.session.get(sessionID); return info?.time.idle !== undefined && (info.time.viewed === undefined || info.time.idle > info.time.viewed) }

upstream_ack_effect.quote: const idle = data.session.get(sessionID)?.time.idle; if (idle === undefined || !isUnread(sessionID) || acknowledged.get(sessionID) === idle) return; acknowledged.set(sessionID, idle); void client.api.session.view({ sessionID, idle }).then(...)

missing_seam.viewed_precondition: Even the viewed half is only partly available: SessionSummary.viewed_at exists on GET /api/sessions, but no CLI code reads viewed_at (grep crates/cli/src for viewed_at returns 0 matches).

focus_half_already_live.note: client_focused: Option<bool> = Some(true) is already tracked (:9037-9052) from FocusGained/FocusLost - the focus input to ViewAcknowledgement::observe is live; the idle/viewed inputs are not.

missing_seam.consequences: Wiring ViewAcknowledgement::poll now is impossible without a value to post. A new producer of the idle-transition timestamp (server SessionSummary field + sessions store read + CLI parse) is required before any client POST can be honest.

focused_test_plan_when_unblocked: server: GET /api/sessions exposes idle (epoch millis / RFC3339) per session; idle advances on a turn settling
cli: parse idle into LiveSnapshot/nav; ViewAcknowledgement.observe(focused, idle, viewed) computes unread
cli: focused + unread posts POST /api/sessions/{id}/view {idle}; unfocused never posts; failure retries 250ms then 5000ms cap; success resets attempts
server: posted idle clamps viewed_at monotonically (existing session_view.rs already covers the clamp)
